letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow of our first morning together, while the monsoon breezes in Ahmedabad whisper your name. I’m constantly amazed by how you turn ordinary moments into sparkling adventures—whether we’re sharing chai on the balcony or strolling beneath the glittering Burj Khalifa lights. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, and your love is the compass that guides me home, no matter where we are. Thank you for being my endless source of joy, my cutie, my everything.
poem:
In desert dunes or rain‑kissed streets,  
Your smile makes my heart skip beats.  
Across the miles, love’s thread we weave,  
Together forever, in every breath we breathe.
